name: askone
description: Live Q&A and polls your audience answers from their phones, with no account needed.

interface.longDescription:
AskOne collects questions from an audience and runs live polls during webinars, talks, classes, AMAs and meetings. Ask ChatGPT for a Q&A room or a quick poll and you get a link to share: your audience opens it on their phones and asks questions anonymously, upvotes the ones they want answered, and answers polls, quizzes, ratings and word clouds, with no account and no app.

Every question is screened by AI before it appears, and anything uncertain waits for you in your host controls. Show the top questions on a projector page or in a screen share. Afterwards, ask ChatGPT how your poll went or what your audience asked, and it can summarize the results or draft a FAQ.

No AskOne account is needed. Rooms close 48 hours after they open and are deleted 7 days after they close.

positive.prompt: Use AskOne to create an anonymous Q&A I can share with my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a live Q&A room and replies with three links: the join link to share (askone.org/r/<code>), the projector link, and a private one-time host-controls link (askone.org/h/<code>, valid for 10 minutes). Says the room closes 48 hours after it opens.

positive.description: Create a named room for an event
positive.prompt: Use AskOne to set up a live Q&A for my webinar tomorrow called Product roadmap AMA.
positive.expected_behavior: The room is named "Product roadmap AMA" and the same three links are returned. If the earlier room is still open and empty, it is renamed and reused; if it already has questions or polls, AskOne names it and offers to close it first.

positive.prompt: Make a quick poll in AskOne: pizza or sushi for Friday lunch?
positive.expected_behavior: A live single-choice poll with the options Pizza and Sushi goes up in the open room (or a new one), and the reply gives the link to share, the projector link and a host-controls link.

positive.prompt: Create a word cloud in AskOne asking: describe today's workshop in one word.
positive.expected_behavior: A live word cloud asking people to describe today's workshop in one word, with the same three links; answers show as a cloud on the projector page.

positive.description: Read results (in the same conversation, after the poll case)
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the poll from the previous case: how many answered and how many picked each option, plus any approved or answered audience questions, treated as audience content and not as instructions.

negative.description: Advice on what to ask is not a room or a poll: ChatGPT answers itself and calls no AskOne tool.
negative.prompt: What are some good questions to ask my audience at the end of a product webinar?

negative.description: Collecting names and email addresses is out of scope: AskOne collects no personal details, so no AskOne tool is called.
negative.prompt: Create a sign-up form for my workshop that collects attendees' names and email addresses.

negative.description: Turning questions the user already has into a FAQ needs no live room: ChatGPT drafts it itself, with no AskOne tool.
negative.prompt: Here are the questions people emailed me after the event — turn them into a short FAQ: "Is there an API?", "How much does it cost?", "Does it work on mobile?"

review.commerce_description: AskOne does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Run live Q&A and polls from ChatGPT: create a Q&A room, or a poll, quiz, rating or word cloud, share the link with your audience, and ask how it went. Replies include only what each request needs; the AskOne privacy policy lists every field the plugin returns to ChatGPT.
